an encoder (300) for encoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence __selected from a group consisting of: frequency of mode usage across previously coded pictures, spatial resolution characteristics, and temporal resolution characteristics__.
